title: Cheap and Tacky, But Pretty Sort Of
text: Cheap and Tacky, But Pretty Sort Of. This is so cheaply made, I'm surprised it survived the shipping. It is pretty when the lights come on though.  In other words it will look good in the dark. Kind of like a bar at closing time. LOL
